answer: Latent slot auction with decaying rebates.** Each identity competes for a scarce execution slot via an auction; losers get only a partial rebate, so cloning multiplies unrecoverable bids. A lantern signal confirms liveness per slot, raising the per-clone overhead. Winners reaching a summit tier unlock a shared vault, but only the primary key can withdraw—clones add cost without access. Marginal clones therefore pay bid loss plus liveness cost while earning nothing, making each one strictly negative-EV.
